name: single-module-jobs-fixpoint
description: Issue #221 guard fixture (residual D): a jobs design with EXACTLY ONE route module, so the jobs `tests/acceptance.rs` AND the route `tests/acceptance.rs` each emit a SINGLE-element `db.migrate(&[...])` array, which rustfmt HUGS onto the `db.migrate(&[` line (de-indenting the sole Migration struct). The multi-field entity keeps its ActiveModel multi-line (clear of residual E) and the cron job name is short (clear of residual F), so this design exercises D in isolation.
